title: Transfer money safely

checks.name: alice has 60 and bob has 90
checks.query: SELECT name, balance FROM accounts WHERE name IN ('alice', 'bob') ORDER BY name

checks.name: the transfer is recorded once
checks.query: SELECT from_name, to_name, amount FROM transfers

checks.name: the rolled-back delete left all three accounts in place

hints: The first transaction is BEGIN; two UPDATEs and one INSERT; COMMIT;
The second is BEGIN; DELETE FROM transfers; DELETE FROM accounts; ROLLBACK;
transfers refers to accounts, so the transfers rows must be deleted before the accounts rows.
